name: WHISKY POKER
description: Whisky Poker is a poker-style game with widow hand exchange. Multiple players. 5 each + 5-card widow. Options: swap entire hand for widow (old hand becomes new widow face-up), swap 1 card with widow, or knock (triggers final round). Last best poker hand after knock wins. Worst hand pays chip.

content.text: Whisky Poker is a poker-style game with widow hand exchange. Multiple players. 5 each + 5-card widow. Options: swap entire hand for widow (old hand becomes new widow face-up), swap 1 card with widow, or knock (triggers final round). Last best poker hand after knock wins. Worst hand pays chip.

Whisky Poker is an American commerce game based on poker hand rankings but with a different mechanism: improving hands by exchanging with a common table hand (the widow). It appears in many late 19th- and early 20th-century North American card game books and is less well known today. A version remains popular in Mexico as La Viuda (the widow).
Standard 52-card pack without jokers; one deck for all player counts (2 to 9).

items.text: La Viuda: Mexican variant: 52 cards plus two jokers (wild); counter-clockwise play; wild card determined by number of chips in pool; optional extra chip La Viuda to re-enter after losing all chips.
